jr--jr-au-louvre.why_en: The Louvre pyramid is covered with a photo of the palace behind it, so from one spot it simply vanishes.
jr--jr-au-louvre.why_zh: 卢浮宫金字塔被贴上身后宫殿的照片，从某个位置看去，它就消失了。

xavi-bou--ornithographies.why_en: Stacking the frames of a bird's flight into one image draws the invisible shape its wings leave in the air.
xavi-bou--ornithographies.why_zh: 把鸟飞行的每一帧叠进一张图里，画出了翅膀在空中留下的、原本看不见的形状。

leandro-erlich--dalston-house.why_en: A house facade lies on the ground under a tilted mirror, so visitors lying on it appear to hang and climb up the building.
leandro-erlich--dalston-house.why_zh: 房屋立面平铺在地上，上方斜挂一面大镜子，躺在上面的人在镜中就像挂在楼上攀爬。

rafael-lozano-hemmer--voice-tunnel.why_en: Your voice becomes a wave of light that runs down a real tunnel.
rafael-lozano-hemmer--voice-tunnel.why_zh: 你的声音变成一道光波，沿着真实的隧道一路跑远。

daniel-rozin--pompom-mirror.why_en: A mirror made of soft fur pom-poms that shows your silhouette as it moves.
daniel-rozin--pompom-mirror.why_zh: 一面由毛绒球组成的镜子，用柔软的毛球映出你移动的轮廓。

random-international--study-for-fifteen-.why_en: Fifteen moving dots of light are enough to see a person walking.
random-international--study-for-fifteen-.why_zh: 只要十五个移动的光点，就能看出一个正在走路的人。

ai-weiwei--safe-passage.why_en: Refugees' life jackets wrap the columns of a Berlin concert hall, bringing the sea crossing onto a landmark.
ai-weiwei--safe-passage.why_zh: 难民留下的救生衣包裹住柏林音乐厅的立柱，把海上逃亡带到了地标建筑上。

christopher-bauder--lichtgrenze.why_en: A line of glowing balloons redraws the vanished Berlin Wall through the city, then lets it float away.
christopher-bauder--lichtgrenze.why_zh: 一排发光气球在城市中重新画出已消失的柏林墙，然后让它飘向夜空。

skullmapping--le-petit-chef.why_en: A tiny projected chef cooks your meal right on your dinner plate.
skullmapping--le-petit-chef.why_zh: 一个投影出来的小厨师，就在你的餐盘上给你做菜。

behnaz-farahi--caress-of-the-gaze.why_en: A garment ripples wherever someone is looking at you, so a gaze becomes something you can see.
behnaz-farahi--caress-of-the-gaze.why_zh: 别人看向你哪里，衣服的那一处就会起伏，目光变成了看得见的东西。

david-bowen--cloud-piano.why_en: Passing clouds press the keys of a real piano, so the sky plays music.
david-bowen--cloud-piano.why_zh: 飘过的云按下真实钢琴的琴键，天空在弹奏音乐。

maarten-baas--schiphol-clock.why_en: A man inside a giant airport clock repaints the hands by hand every minute.
maarten-baas--schiphol-clock.why_zh: 机场巨大的时钟里有一个人，每分钟亲手重画一次指针。

bruno-catalano--les-voyageurs.why_en: Travellers with their bodies torn away, so the harbour behind them shows through.
bruno-catalano--les-voyageurs.why_zh: 旅人的身体缺了一大块，身后的港口从空洞中透出来。

olafur-eliasson--ice-watch.why_en: Blocks of Greenland ice melt in a city square, so people can touch climate change with their hands.
olafur-eliasson--ice-watch.why_zh: 格陵兰的冰块在城市广场上融化，人们可以用手摸到气候变化。

theo-jansen--strandbeest-evolution.why_en: Creatures made of plastic tubes walk along the beach powered only by the wind.
theo-jansen--strandbeest-evolution.why_zh: 用塑料管做成的生物，只靠风力就在沙滩上行走。
